By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' shows that Solokin Sakellar was the [[Grand Warden/Legends|Grand Warden]] of the [[University of Yabol Opa/Legends|University of Yabol Opa]] and lived in a [[Coruscant Lodge of Solokin Sakellar/Legends|skyscraper lodge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[in-universe]] events of {{Film|II}}. As ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that film to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Sakellar had to have become the University of Yabol Opa's Grand Warden and started to live in the Coruscant skyscraper lodge that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] at latest.</ref> '''Solokin Sakellar''' was the [[Grand Warden/Legends|Grand Warden]] and absolute ruler of the [[University of Yabol Opa/Legends|University of Yabol Opa]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-wide [[University/Legends|university]] encompassing the [[Yabol Opa/Legends|eponymous world]]<ref name="Inside" /> located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Also by 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Sakellar maintained a [[Coruscant Lodge of Solokin Sakellar/Legends|skyscraper lodge]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
Solokin Sakellar was created in [[2003]]'s reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside" />
